label: selectionInverted: From Selection hides the marquee and shows the rest
find: let c = selectionCoverage(x: x + layer.offsetX, y: y + layer.offsetY)
replace: let c = 1 - selectionCoverage(x: x + layer.offsetX, y: y + layer.offsetY)

label: cropSkipped: a crop leaves the mask where and as big as it was
applyTwoSteps: Apply records a second step for the dropped mask
applyIgnoresAlpha: Apply hides the colour but keeps the alpha
resizeNotFitted: Image Size leaves the mask its old size
canvasGrowSkipped: Canvas Size leaves a padded background's mask small
